$comment: Legal policy registry (Phase 7). Texts live in the web app's content files; this file holds versions, the operator and grievance contact, processors and retention. status stays draft until a lawyer approves a version; production refuses to start unless LEGAL_APPROVED_VERSION equals `version`.

grievance_officer.note: Name and contact are required in the privacy notice; response timelines to be set with the lawyer (DPDP rules).

processors.data: Payment details are entered with Razorpay; we receive payment ids, amounts and status
Call audio in transit, session ids

processors.purpose: Horoscope prose drafts; AI assistant answers when enabled
processors.data: Computed chart placements and the question (no name, phone or birth details)
processors.founder_to_fill: Google (Gemini) and/or Anthropic (Claude), paid no-training tier

proposed.ledger_and_invoices: Kept as required by tax law even after account deletion (identity removed)
proposed.kyc_documents: To be set with the lawyer
